name: MTPCode Testers
tagline: Find Testers. Test Apps. Get Real Feedback.
description: MTPCode Testers is a community platform connecting Android developers with real testers for genuine testing tasks and structured feedback — not an install exchange. Developers submit apps and create testing campaigns; testers get matched automatically by device, Android version and hardware, complete structured tasks, and submit ratings and bug reports. Includes a credit/reputation/badge system, campaign reporting (PDF/CSV), and a full admin panel.
features: Server-side tester matching by Android version, architecture, hardware and country
Structured testing tasks, sessions and completion tracking
5-category star ratings plus bug reports with screenshot/video attachments
Ledger-based credits, recoverable reputation score, and unlockable badges
Campaign testing reports — JSON, branded PDF, and CSV export
Test Squads — mutual-testing cohorts with progress tracking
In-app notifications, and a full web admin panel for platform moderation
Material 3 design, dark mode, adaptive tablet layout

notes: Initial release — full-stack platform: Laravel API, web landing + admin panel, Flutter Android app
All 14 planned phases built: auth, apps, campaigns, tester matching, tasks, feedback/bugs, credits/reputation, squads, reporting, admin, notifications, Play Billing foundation
Deployed to production at mtpcode.in, verified on a real Android device
